objective: Proof and exhaustive finite check. Reduce creation at a line of a chain's last atom, through PENDANT-LINE A's two-round rule, to the near side's relations on that line and up to two further points; carry them along the chain by a profile at each cut (the prefix's relations on the cut's three ports and up to two further points); compute every profile reachable through chains of Fano atoms of any length, by closure under every splice; and check the touching rule on every reachable profile with every last atom. Validate the reduction and the automaton against the creation map on built chains.
status: Proved: the touching rule at every distance in Fano trees (a chain carries one of 47 profiles, closed after three atoms; 12,894 of 12,894 verdicts); free ports; the receiving atom alone decides creation
title: Creation along chains of every length
